text:
Maddie: Quick sync — iterating landing hero + launch posts for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need final hero line + two short launch posts, and routing for webinar signups -> SDR queue by EOD. Doc: https://docs.google.com/rdw/landing-refresh (WIP).

Luis (Designer): I pushed hero comps to the doc (bottom). Variant A is more product-led, B is benefits-led. Visuals ready for A.

Asha (Content): Sharing three micro-props to test under hero: 
- Predictable latency, predictable cost
- One API, any deployment (hosted, reserved, private)
- Move fast without ops overhead

Ravi (Growth): For launch posts we need 2 hooks: one benchmark-led (latency/cost) and one onboarding-led (fast demo -> signup). Suggest tweet-length + LinkedIn copy.

Noah (Sales): For Dedicated/Private leads, route webinar signups to "enterprise-funnel" tag — need fields: company size, compliance needs, cloud/on-prem. If not provided, route to MQL queue.

Maddie: Good — make routing explicit. Proposed mapping: webinar RSVP -> capture tier (hosted/dedicated/private) from form -> if "private" or "dedicated" AND company_size > 250 -> enterprise SDRs (Noah). Else -> inbound SDRs (Ravi). Ivy, can you wire that? ops-bot, any rate limits on form events?

ops-bot: Reminder: event pipeline can handle up to 300 reqs/min per region. Add debouncing if you expect spikes.

Ivy (Webdev): Can implement hidden field to capture "deployment_interest" and pass to Segment. Will add validation for company_size integer. ETA 4 hours.

Asha (Content): Drafts below — please react with :1: for benchmark, :2: for onboarding.

---BENCHMARK POST (short)---
Maddie: "Redwood Inference: 3x cheaper per token and 40% lower 95th p99 latency vs baseline on common LLM workloads. Ship features faster with predictable inference economics. Join our webinar to see the numbers + live demo. [register link]"

---ONBOARDING POST (short)---
Maddie: "Launch LLM features in hours — same API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. See a live demo and migration playbook on our webinar. Seats limited: [register link]"

Luis (Designer): Hero lines — A: "Inference you can count on." B: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency, cost, and control." C (short): "Fast. Cheap. Reliable inference"

Ravi (Growth): Suggest caption variants for LinkedIn: expand benchmark post with a short stat callout + CTA to webinar gated by company size. Use UTM tags: ?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=linkedin&utm_campaign=landing_refresh

Noah (Sales): Add checkbox on RSVP: "Interested in Dedicated or Private deployment" so SDRs can prioritize. Also include "Best time to talk" slots.

Asha (Content): Microcopy for hero CTA: "See live demo" (primary) and "Get migration checklist" (secondary). For enterprise journey CTA: "Request a private walkthrough" (goes to Noah).

Maddie: Decision needed: hero variant and primary CTA. Meeting at 2pm to lock. If no objections, we'll go with Variant B + primary CTA "See live demo" and route enterprise interest to Noah's queue.

Luis (Designer): :thumbsup: B looks best to me. I'll update artboard.

Ivy (Webdev): I'll wire CTA and Segment events. Also will add debounce and server-side validation per ops-bot.

Noah (Sales): :white_check_mark: routing noted. Will prep SDR playbook with prioritization rules.

Asha (Content): I'll finalize landing microcopy and two launch post variants for scheduling.

Maddie: Awesome — thanks team. Final checklist before 2pm:
- Luis: update hero art + export assets
- Asha: final copy + CTA microcopy
- Ivy: form fields + Segment events wired + test deploy
- Ravi/Noah: SDR routing & playbook ready
- Ops-bot: confirm pipeline headroom (ack by 1:30pm)

Maddie: If anyone sees blockers DM me. Otherwise I'll run the 2pm sync and post final push notes to #launch-planning. :rocket:
